nodes.name: Set Config
nodes.notes:
CONFIGURATION NODE - Edit these values to customize your invoice automation.

1. invoicingProvider: Choose 'quickbooks', 'stripe', or 'pdf_only'
2. crmProvider: Choose 'hubspot', 'airtable', or 'manual'
3. sheetId: Your Google Sheets ID (from the URL)
4. driveRootFolderId: Optional Google Drive folder for PDFs
5. ownerNotificationEmail: Your email for alerts
6. testMode: Set to true to send all emails to yourself first

nodes.name: Webhook Trigger
nodes.notes:
WEBHOOK TRIGGER

Send POST requests to this webhook URL with the invoice payload.

Required fields:
- client_name
- client_email
- billable_event_id
- items (array)
- total

Optional fields:
- client_company, client_id
- invoice_number_optional
- subtotal, tax, discount
- notes, po_number
- service_period_start/end

nodes.name: Daily at 9 AM
nodes.notes: DAILY REMINDER CHECK - Runs at 9:00 AM daily.

parameters.jsonOutput: ={{ const daysSinceSent = $json.calc.days_since_sent; const daysOverdue = $json.calc.days_overdue; const isOverdue = $json.calc.is_overdue; const cadence = $('Load Config').item.json.config.reminderCadenceDays; const weeklyAfter = $('Load Config').item.json.config.weeklyAfterDays; const finalNoticeDays = $('Load Config').item.json.config.finalNoticeDaysOverdue; let shouldSend = false; let reminderType = ''; for (const day of cadence) { if (daysSinceSent === day) { shouldSend = true; reminderType = isOverdue ? 'past_due' : 'friendly'; break; } } if (!shouldSend && daysSinceSent >= weeklyAfter && (daysSinceSent - weeklyAfter) % 7 === 0) { shouldSend = true; reminderType = 'past_due'; } if (daysOverdue >= finalNoticeDays && $json.last_reminder_type !== 'final_notice') { shouldSend = true; reminderType = 'final_notice'; } if (isOverdue && !$json.last_reminder_ts) { shouldSend = true; reminderType = 'past_due'; } ({ should_send: shouldSend, reminder_type: reminderType, days_since_sent: daysSinceSent, days_overdue: daysOverdue, is_overdue: isOverdue }) }}
